effective_rank_diagnostic.role: localization only; effective rank is not a model-selection metric

interpretation.established: Multiplicative query-content modulation connected target/rank queries to Program-conditioned factor content: own-direct cosine rose from v4 0.0184 to 0.0821 and retrieval rose from 1/24 to 3/24. It still failed every material gate, and effective magnitude fell to 0.0864 of the direct adapters.
interpretation.earliest_interface: The remaining failure is earlier than another query or loss-weight tweak. q_pi still summarizes only successful-member factors and a compressed successful-occupancy response, while Stage 1 omits learner occupancy, source/shared policy support and task-equal success/progress. The compiler therefore receives an underidentified privileged Program and converges near the zero-update solution of the relative exact-BA objective.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This rejects the v5 query-content coordinate bootstrap and further local compiler/query iteration on the same evidence. It does not reject the ECP Program/compiler contract or policy-functional training, because the expert-required multi-state support and closed-loop objectives were absent from v5.

decision.next: Keep the v5 Program/compiler content-address contract, replace the privileged evidence and Stage 1 objective with a policy-support teacher using successful occupancy, verified or uncertainty-weighted learner occupancy, source/shared support and task-equal success/progress. Rank remains an unordered numeric factor coordinate and is not added as a Program semantic axis.
